node.title: MCA coordinate-clone subcritical-class payment
node.closure: exact bidegree incidence payment and unique-large-class reduction
node.statement: In a deployed owner pencil after fixed-slope, fixed-owner, and identically-zero coordinate curves are routed separately, partition the nonzero coordinate curves by common irreducible bidegree-(1,1) component. For every clone class C of size 2<=c<m, any rich parameter point assigned to that component needs at least m-c outside coordinate equations, while each outside bidegree-(1,1) curve meets the component in at most two points. Hence N_C(m-c)<=2(n-c) and, because n<=2(m-1), N_C<=2c. Summing all subcritical classes gives at most 2n=4194304 rich parameter pairs, below both deployed MCA budgets. Since n<2m, at most one clone class has size at least m. Thus every unpaid coordinate-clone exception is reduced to one unique large clone component; that component is not paid here.
